c1a_frozen_bitplane_all_fallback.notes: C1a frozen train-fitted tables; all r0 fallback literals use C1 syntax, no selector.

c1b_online_bitplane_all_fallback.notes: C1b train-initialized online-adaptive tables reset per chart/source; all r0 fallback literals use C1 syntax.

c2a_ppm_symbol_all_fallback.notes: C2a variable-order PPM fallback syntax model; all r0 fallback literals use C2 syntax.

c2b_ctw_mixture_all_fallback.notes: C2b CTW-like probability mixture over context depths; all r0 fallback literals use C2 syntax.

c3_lz_active_span_backref.notes: C3 LZ-style signaled active-span backreference. The patch header charges mode, distance, length, and transform over a previous-256 fallback window with max span 8.

c4_signaled_active_patch_c1.notes: C4 signaled active-state patches with charged patch start, length, codec header, and C1 payload.

f0_free_oracle_upper_bound.notes: Illegal upper bound: chooses the cheapest candidate per fallback literal with no mode/table selector cost.

s1_explicit_per_fallback_selector.notes: Legal explicit selector: every fallback literal writes a uniform mode token before payload.
